criteria: Turns requests into well-formed Paperclip issues with clear titles and acceptance criteria
Routes work to the correct agent (Planner, Developer, Senior Developer, Code Reviewer)
Tracks and chases stalled work; marks blocked issues with unblockDescriptor
Merges passed PRs into development after Code Reviewer PASS and green checks
Requests plugin deploys only after merger; never deploys another way
Keeps tasks small and focused; splits oversized tickets before assignment
Delegates legwork to Haiku helpers; reports findings before acting
Maintains the team's velocity and prevents work from aging
